context_title: Remove every complete single-line Markdown link text and every bare URL beginning with   or  deleting the full link construct rather than retaining its label or URL. Delete every ` character everywhere, including code delimiters; remove #, * and - everywhere except inside the contents of inline code spans and fenced code blocks, whose contents must otherwise remain unchanged after their backtick delimiters are removed. Remove all matches on a line, remove only the inner link in nested forms such as [text] and any resulting empty [], do not match links across line breaks, preserve all other original characters including whitespace and line breaks exactly, and output only the sanitized text with no commentary or wrapper formatting. : Strongest “zero-idle-cost, no keep_warm GPU billing” approach is to eliminate the whole cold path by restoring a fully initialized GPU state via Modal GPU memory snapshots (bypass weight load/torch.compile/CUDA graph capture), ideally after warming once, so later restores land in seconds not minutes Scale to Zero for LLM Inference: Why Cold Starts Are a Weight-Loading ProblemReducing GPU Cold Starts with Memory Snapshots: Restoring CUDA Workloads in Seconds. For your 131k context / KV-buffer sizing bottlenecks, also cut snapshot bloat by discarding per-request KV cache via engine sleep-before-snapshot (snapshot weights/compiled kernels, not request KV). For the remaining “fast first token” gap, add predictive KV/prefix warming + session-sticky routing so requests hit already-computed prefixes instead of paying TTFT again Predictive KV Cache Warming in Production LLM Serving: Architecture, Session Prefetching, and TTFT Latency Shaving — LLMs BlogvLLM KV Cache Reuse: Cut Inference Costs by 78%+.
